svg.title: A VLM in the stack
svg.desc: Block diagram of a VLM in the robot stack. Top row, left to right: Camera, Encode and ask, VLM (blue, a model). Arrow 1 goes from the camera to Encode and ask; arrow 2 from Encode and ask to the VLM; arrow 3 goes down from the VLM to Check. Bottom row, right to left: ROS topics, Check, Record, LLM agent (blue, a model). Arrow 6 goes from ROS topics to Check, arrow 4 from Check to Record, arrow 5 from Record to the LLM agent. A red dashed arrow, 7, goes from Check back up to Encode and ask.
